title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Network initiated detach procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to detach a UE from the network.

entities.name: DETACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the network to initiate detach procedure.

entities.name: DETACH ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by the network to accept detach procedure.

entities.name: Detach type
entities.description: IE indicating type of detach: IMSI detach, re-attach required, or re-attach not required.

entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: IE indicating EMM cause value, e.g., #2 'IMSI unknown in HSS'.

entities.name: T3422
entities.description: Timer used for retransmission of DETACH REQUEST message.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state indicating UE is deregistered from the network.

entities.name: IMSI detach or re-attach not required with EMM cause #2
entities.description: Condition where detach type is IMSI detach or re-attach not required and EMM cause is #2 'IMSI unknown in HSS'.

entities.name: Re-attach not required with no EMM cause or other cause
entities.description: Condition where detach type is re-attach not required with no EMM cause IE or EMM cause other than #2.

entities.name: Re-attach required
entities.description: Condition where detach type indicates re-attach required.

entities.name: Abort detach procedure
entities.description: Behavior where the network aborts the ongoing detach procedure.

entities.name: Change to EMM-DEREGISTERED state
entities.description: Behavior where the network changes the EMM state to EMM-DEREGISTERED.

relations.description: Network initiated detach procedure involves sending DETACH REQUEST message.
DETACH REQUEST message contains Detach type IE.
DETACH REQUEST message may contain EMM cause IE.
Network starts timer T3422 on retransmission of DETACH REQUEST.
Network stops timer T3422 when detach procedure is aborted.
Condition leads to aborting detach procedure.
Condition leads to changing to EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Detach type IE value guards condition for state change.
EMM cause IE value guards condition for state change.
Detach procedure may require transition to EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
